title: Distal Tibia and Fibula Fracture Radiograph
author: Jalo
caption: Anteroposterior plain radiograph demonstrating displaced fractures of the distal tibia and fibula.
alt_text: X-ray radiograph of the lower leg showing displaced fractures of the distal tibia and fibula.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates radiographic appearance of combined distal tibia-fibula fracture requiring immobilization and potential surgical reduction (CLIFF-045, p.4-5).
